title: Seville Cathedral
text: A stunning piece of history with a guided tour that gave great detail. Loved it
author: Bert O

title: We had a wonderful tour...
text:
We had a wonderful tour of the **Seville Cathedral** with our guide Margarita. She was extremely knowledgeable and shared a wealth of information about the cathedral in a very engaging and professional way. We especially appreciated that she even extended her time with us, which made the experience feel more personal and relaxed.

We found the story about **Christopher Columbus** and his remains particularly fascinating—it really added depth to the visit.

Overall, it was an informative and memorable experience, and we highly recommend this tour.
author: James_L

title: Great up close Cathedral Tour
text:
The guide was great and allowed our group time for photos.  My understanding of cathedral and its history are excellent.
 As to the guide, she was on time, clear and gave great information.
